title: Rewind to the budget origin
statement: Let $W$ be a finite Turing machine over Boolean symbols, let $a,j\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $x$ be a finite word over the schedule alphabet determined by $W$ and $a$. For any base configuration on $x$, input-head position, integers $u,g$, Boolean word $w$, and unary-counter and guide tapes, running the length-only schedule for $j+1$ steps from the configuration in budget-back phase with budget head at cell $j$ and captured clock tape for $w$ yields the configuration in append phase with counter $0$, budget head at cell $1$, the same base data, input head, unary tape and head, guide tape and head, and captured clock tape.
hypotheses_covered: schedule input x and base configuration
replaced:
For every $j \in \bbn$: from a setup configuration in the budget-back phase with budget
head at cell $j$ over the captured clock tape of a bit word $w$, exactly $j+1$ steps
reach the sentinel at the origin and move right once, entering the first append phase
with budget head at cell $1$; all tapes and all other heads are unchanged.
